The companys ethos is built upon the philosophy of Marketing Engineered - an approach that delivers marketing and sales solutions through innovative ideas in design, engineering, and technology. 
 Role in the organization: Amura is looking for a Senior Web Developer - Frontend who is passionate about building high-quality, visually engaging, and performance-driven web experiences. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive development, animations, and modern frontend technologies , with the ability to convert creative designs into pixel-perfect, interactive websites. You will work closely with UX/UI designers, developers, project managers, and clients to deliver scalable and engaging digital experiences. The role requires strong attention to detail, ownership of deliverables, problem-solving ability, and the ability to mentor junior developers. 
 Key Responsibilities: Lead the frontend development of responsive, interactive, and visually engaging websites and web applications. Translate Figma, Photoshop, Adobe XD, and other design mockups into pixel-perfect, production-ready code. Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable frontend components and code structures. Develop complex CSS3, JavaScript, SVG, and HTML5 animations to create engaging user experiences. Implement advanced interactions, transitions, micro-animations, and motion effects based on design requirements. Ensure websites are fully responsive and cross-browser compatible across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Work closely with UX/UI designers to understand designs, identify implementation challenges, and suggest technically feasible solutions. Collaborate with backend developers and other technical teams to ensure smooth integration of frontend components with APIs and web services. Review code for quality, performance, maintainability, and adherence to frontend development standards. Identify and resolve UI, cross-browser, responsiveness, and performance-related issues . Optimize websites for page speed, rendering performance, responsiveness, and overall user experience . Conduct performance debugging, benchmarking, and frontend optimization wherever required. Stay updated with emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, libraries, and development practices. Participate in Agile development processes, sprint planning, code reviews, and project discussions. Take ownership of frontend deliverables and ensure timely completion as per project requirements and client feedback. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior frontend developers. Assist in troubleshooting and resolving complex frontend development issues. Ensure consistency in design implementation and user experience across different pages and platforms. Support the team in evaluating new technologies, tools, libraries, and approaches for web development. Train and guide users/colleagues on relevant web technologies and applications when required. 
 Skills Required: 2.5 - 5 years of professional experience in frontend/web development. Strong expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, SASS/SCSS, Bootstrap, and Responsive Web Design . Strong command of modern CSS concepts including Flexbox, Grid, positioning, transitions, transforms, and responsive layouts . Strong experience in developing pixel-perfect websites from Figma/Photoshop/Adobe XD designs . Excellent understanding of cross-browser compatibility and responsive web development . Strong knowledge of SVG and HTML5/CSS3 animations . Hands-on experience with JavaScript-based interactions and frontend development. Strong understanding of web performance optimization , including page load, rendering, asset optimization, and browser performance. Ability to write clean, reusable, scalable, and maintainable code . Good understanding of frontend debugging and browser developer tools. Strong attention to detail with a focus on pixel-perfect implementation . Ability to work in a fast-paced, Agile environment and deliver within tight timelines. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to independently handle frontend development tasks from design handoff to final implementation. Good to Have / Additional Skills: Experience with animation libraries such as: GSAP (GreenSock) Anime.js PixiJS CreateJS Strong experience with SVG animations and Canvas animations . Experience with 3D web animations and libraries such as Three.js . Knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks such as: React.js / Next.js Vue.js / Nuxt.js Three.js Experience working with WebGL or interactive 3D experiences. Understanding of animation principles, motion design, and interactive storytelling. Experience with Git/version control systems. Familiarity with frontend build tools and development workflows. Experience working with CMS platforms or API-driven websites will be an added advantage. 
 What We re Looking For: A developer who combines strong technical skills with an eye for design . Someone who cares about pixel-perfect execution and user experience . Someone who can independently take ownership of frontend projects and deliver high-quality work. A problem solver who can identify technical challenges and propose practical solutions. Someone who enjoys experimenting with animations, interactions, and emerging web technologies . A team player who can collaborate effectively with designers, developers, and other stakeholders. Someone willing to mentor junior developers and contribute to improving frontend development practices within the team. 
 Why Join Amura Work on diverse and challenging digital experiences for leading brands. Opportunity to work closely with creative, UX, technology, and marketing teams. Exposure to modern frontend technologies, animations, and interactive web experiences. Fast-paced environment with opportunities to experiment and innovate. Opportunity to work on projects where design, engineering, and technology come together .

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Software Engineer(React js Developer)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible.
   

  

 Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 A unified internal platform that enables Mastercard teams to design, build, govern, and distribute consistent, accessible, and analytics enabled UI experiences across channels using reusable frameworks, automation, and embedded governance.
   

  

 Do you like to be part of a team that creates and executes strategic initiatives centered around consistent user experiences?
   

  

 Do you look forward to developing and engaging with high performant diverse teams around the globe?
   

  

 Would you like to be part of a highly visible, strategically important global engineering organization?
   

  

**The Role**
 What’s it all about and what we expect you to do day to day?
   

  

 Own software delivery tasks (code development, test, deployment, release, configuration and documentation) at an application/software component level
   

  

 Able to troubleshoot and refactor existing code for exceptional code quality.
   

  

 Adopt new languages and architecture patterns needed for the work.
   

  

 Participate and contribute to team’s agile process and decisions. Understand and contribute to Prioritization.
   

  

 Pull from backlog and deliver work after seeking guidance from experienced team members and in partnership with full scrum team.
   

  

 Automate build, operate, and run aspects of software.
   

  

 Drive code/design/process trade\-off discussions within their team when required.
   

  

 Drive integration of services focusing on customer journey and experience.
   

  

 Perform demos/acceptance discussions in interacting with Product owners.
   

  

 Understands operational and engineering experience, actively works to improve experience and metrics in ownership area.
   

  

 Develop complete understanding of end\-to\-end technical architecture and dependency systems.
   

  

 Drive adoption of technology standards and opinionated frameworks, and review coding, test, and automation work of team members.
   

  

 Mentor and guide new and less\-experienced team members.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to improve an overall process and trim waste.
   

  

 Share and seek knowledge within their Guild/Program to drive reuse of patterns/libraries/practices and enhance productivity.
   

  

**All About You And What You Need To Bring**
 Has ability to write secure code in three or more languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript, Typescript,SQL)
   

  

 Familiar with secure coding standards (e.g., OWASP, CWE, SEI CERT) and vulnerability management
   

  

 Infrastructure as code and cloud first software development knowledge experience preferred.
   

  

 Understands and implements standard branching (e.g., Gitflow) and peer review practices. Move the team towards trunk based development
   

  

 Apply tools (e.g., Sonar, Zally, Checkmarx ) and techniques to scan and measure code quality and anti\-patterns as part of development activity
   

  

 Has skills in test driven and behavior driven development (TDD and BDD) to build just enough code and collaborate on the desired functionality. Ability to keep the full testing pyramid healthy \- Has skills to author test code with lots of smaller tests followed by few contract tests at service level and fewer journey tests at the integration level
   

  

 Understands the use of basic design patterns (e.g., factory, adaptor, singleton, composite, observer, strategy, inversion of control)
   

  

 Understands use cases for advanced design patterns (e.g., service\-to\-worker, MVC, API gateway, intercepting filter, dependency injection, lazy loading, all from the gang of four) to implement efficient code
   

  

 Understands and implements Application Programming Interface (API) standards and cataloging to drive API/service adoption and commercialization and effort estimation
   

  

 Experienced in agile and modern SDLC practices (Scrum/Kanban/Continuous Delivery/DevOps/Quality engineering) and the delivery situations they are used for
   

  

 Has skills to elaborate and estimate non\-functional requirements, including security (e.g., data protection, authentication, authorization), regulatory, and performance (SLAs, throughput, transactions per second)
   

  

 Has skills to orchestrate release workflows and pipelines, and apply standardized pipelines via APIs to achieve CI and CD using industry standard tools (e.g., Jenkins, AWS/Azure pipelines, XL Release, others).
   

  

 Familiar with different application patterns to implement different types of business processes (e.g., APIs, event\-driven\-services, batch\-services, web\-applications, big data)
   

  

 Experience in Continuous Integration (CI) and Delivery (CD) concepts, and capabilities to support automation, pipelines, virtualization, and containerization
   

  

 Able to perform debugging and troubleshooting to analyze core, heap, thread dumps and remove coding errors
   

  

 Has skills to conduct product demos and co\-ordinate with product owners to drive product acceptance signoffs
   

  

 Has skills to Understands customer journeys and ensure a Mastercard good experience by continuously reducing Mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for incidents and ensuring high availability (99\.95% as a starting point)
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
